logs.content:
[red]v26.07.29
    - Fixed legacy FilePicker injection for live voice-note recording
    - Native voice compatibility diagnostics and transmit-only fallback
    - Typing and voice status moved directly below the input prompt
    - Removed dependency version pins to allow compatible resolution
    - Fixed Python 3.14 upload picker filetype handling
    - Fixed exact Quick Go destinations and punctuation matching
    - Live microphone recording stored as MP3 for voice notes
    - Full-duplex voice channel microphone and speaker audio
    - Voice member list and live speaking indicator
    - Quick Go channel and DM search
    - Live valid-command underline lexer
    - Discord voice-note sending
    - Sticker display and terminal preview
    - Any-file upload and download
    - Voice-channel join, move, status, and leave
    - Incoming and outgoing typing indicators
    - Structured OOP package
    - Chafa iTerm image preview
    - Reply-to-you indicator
    - Role-based username color option
    - Persistent startup notifications
    - Synchronized local timestamps
    - Topmost upload picker
    - Message bookmarks
    - Per-channel notification sounds[/red]

[red]Quick Go and navigation:
    -k <query>                  Search every text channel and DM, then go directly when one result matches.
    -k <server / #channel>      Open an exact completed Quick Go destination.
    -k <result no.>             Open a numbered result from the last Quick Go search.
    -s <server name>            Select a server. Type the start of its name for completion.
    -c <channel name>           Open a text channel in the selected server.
    -cf <username>              Open a direct-message conversation.
    -<                          Show the next older page of chat history.
    ->                          Show the next newer page of chat history.

Messages:
    -r <message no.> <text>     Reply to a displayed message. Staged files are included.
    -e <message no.> <text>     Edit one of your messages. Omit text to load it into the input.
    -d <message no. ...>        Delete one or more of your displayed messages.
    -fw <message no.> <user>    Forward the text of a message to a direct-message user.
    -y <message no.>            Copy a message's text to the clipboard.
    -p <message no.>            Pin a message.
    -dp <message no.>           Unpin a message.
    -ct <message no.> <emoji>   Add a reaction using an emoji or emoji alias.

Files, images, stickers, and voice notes:
    -up                         Open a topmost picker and stage any file for the next message or reply.
    -deup                       Remove every currently staged upload.
    -dw <message no.>           Download every attachment from a message into the download folder.
    -dw <message no.> <no. ...> Download only the selected attachment numbers.
    -open <message no.> <no. ...> Save and open selected attachments with the operating system.
    -v <message no.> <image no.> Preview an image attachment using Chafa iTerm symbols.
    -v <message no.> s<no.>     Preview a PNG, APNG, or GIF sticker; Lottie stickers are identified but cannot be rendered by Chafa.
    -v :emoji:                  Preview a custom emoji image using Chafa iTerm symbols.
    -vn                         Record from the microphone until Enter, store an MP3, and send it as a Discord voice note.
    -vn <audio path>            Send the specified audio file as a Discord voice note. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe in PATH.

Voice channels:
    -vc                         List voice channels in the selected server.
    -vc <channel name or ID>    Join or move to voice and transmit your microphone. Compatible native voice also enables hearing members.
    -vcs                        Show connection mode, channel, members, and speaking, muted, or deafened status.
    -lvc                        Stop audio devices and leave the current voice channel.

Typing indicators:
    -typing                     Show whether your outgoing typing signal is enabled.
    -typing on                  Send Discord typing events while composing a normal message.
    -typing off                 Stop sending your typing events. Incoming typing remains directly below the prompt.

Notifications:
    -ntf                        List stored pings and direct messages found since the previous session.
    -cntf / /cntf              Clear all stored notifications.
    -gntf <notification no.>    Open the channel and message belonging to a notification.

Bookmarks:
    -bm <message no.>           Save a displayed message as a bookmark.
    -bms                        List saved bookmarks.
    -dbm <bookmark no.>         Delete a bookmark from the list.
    -gbm <bookmark no.>         Open the channel and message belonging to a bookmark.

Other:
    -help                       Show this full command reference.
    -changelog                  Show the feature changelog.
    -conf                       Show the current reserved configuration-editor status.
    -q                          Close the client.[/red]

[red]Voice mixer controls:
    -vc <channel name or ID>    Join or move to voice, hear members, and transmit your microphone.
    -vcs                        Show live members, speaking state, mixer state, devices, and received/output byte counts.
    -vmute <member|self>        Locally mute a member, or mute your outgoing microphone.
    -vunmute <member|self>      Locally unmute a member, or unmute your outgoing microphone.
    -vvol <member|self> <0-200> Set local member volume or your outgoing microphone gain percentage.

Voice device configuration:
    settings.voice_audio.input_device accepts a sounddevice input device name or index.
    settings.voice_audio.output_device accepts a sounddevice output device name or index.
    Use null for either value to use the operating-system default device.[/red]

[red]Voice update:
    - Fixed receive buffering so decoded packet remainders are no longer discarded
    - Guarded input and output callbacks so one audio error does not silently stop playback
    - Added live member names and speaking status below the prompt
    - Added per-member and self mute and volume controls
    - Added input/output device configuration and -vcs audio diagnostics[/red]
